episode.title: The Oldest Message In A Bottle Spent Over 130 Years At Sea

synopsis: An ocean bottle containing a message drifted at sea for over 130 years before being found on a beach.

title_card.title: A message in a bottle floated 130 years.
title_card.subtitle: It spent more than 130 years at sea.

caption:
The oldest known message in a bottle spent more than 130 years at sea.

Jettisoned in 1886 from a German sailing ship into the Indian Ocean, the bottle was finally retrieved in 2018 on an Australian beach. A hand-written note inside revealed details of the voyage.
